question: Who among the following persons was elected as the Vice President of Asia Pacific Broadcasting Union in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shashi Shekhar Vempati**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• He was elected as **the Vice President of Asia Pacific Broadcasting Union (ABU)** in December 2020 for **three years**.
 
• The Asia-Pacific Broadcasting Union was founded in **1964.**
 
• It is a **non-profit**,** professional association of broadcasting organizations**.
 
• Currently, it comprises over **280 members in 57 countries** and regions.
 
• **Headquarters: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rakesh Mohan**

 
 
• Rakesh Mohan is an **Indian economist and former Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India**.
 
• He is **the Vice-Chairperson of the Indian Institute for Human Settlements. ** 
 
 
 
• **Bina Agarwal** 
 
 
• Bina Agarwal is an** Indian development economist and Professor of Development Economics and Environment at the Global Development Institute at The University of Manchester.**
 
 
 
• **​Hemant Pandey**
 
 
• Hemant Pandey is an** Indian film, theatre, and television actor**.
